::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Novr 30th [1867?]  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Charlotte Mitchell.
:::

My dear [Mrs Johns](people/person_772.qmd),
I am afraid my [mother](people/person_1606.qmd) can hardly venture to the entertainment your elegant little square so pleasantly holds out, but I hope I may be able to come - and if it is any convenience to you in making arrangements I could take up [Miss Wilford](people/person_1520.qmd) and bring her back, but pray do not trouble yourself to answer

yours sincerely
C M Yonge
